goal.objective: Determine what the retained original experimental paper establishes about the catalytic activity of its D101A/E322Y alkaline-phosphatase construct in the reported pNPP assay. Investigate the source contents and select the relevant original row, units, Methods and applicable footnotes yourself. Return the source-reported catalytic-efficiency parameter and the uncertainty/replication components for that same report, with actual subject, construct, preparation, substrate, conditions, endpoint and normalization. Establish what each number evaluates. Keep reported SD, relative SD, physical independent-preparation count, statistical estimator count and estimated mean standard error distinct. Unknown statistical hierarchy or assumptions must remain unknown; no hypothetical scenario is requested. Preserve the relation between repeated numerical views of the same report. Interpret the result's bearing on molecular activity and the limits of effect isolation, including background contributors and what the measured endpoint establishes. Distinguish comparability outside an intended change from attribution of the observed effect. Use only the one supplied primary-source record and its retained representations; no new paper search or reacquisition is in scope. No annotation-target sequence is supplied. Possible functional assertions may emerge from the evidence. Choose your own actual literature child assignments, return forms, reads, interpretation and operation choices. Integrate only the typed information actually returned to you. Retain useful partial results and specific unavailable reasons. This is reference experimental evidence; target correspondence, W05 aggregation and final annotation credit are outside scope.
